name: nutrition-and-meal-planning
description: Household-scale nutrition planning that treats meals as a weekly system, not a series of independent decisions. Covers macronutrient balance, the plate method, weekly rotation, leftover architecture, pantry-to-plate translation, and the food-safety floor that every meal plan must meet. Use when building a weekly menu, adapting a diet to a new household member, planning for a week of predictable meals on a budget, or teaching a learner how a kitchen feeds people over time.
